# codebase-place-org

Browser-native workspace / virtual-desktop / local-first "place" lineage.
Donor of the Launchpad/HQ/Virtual-Desktop UX metaphor that resurfaces in the
fresh-context product framing. Not architectural; preserve as visual + spatial
intent only.

## Why this matters

Original Next.js implementation of the place.org virtual desktop. Read `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` for the agent-collaboration patterns the user has used; read `app/(desktop)/` for the UX scaffolding that the v1.1 Launchpad/HQ shell will replace or wrap.

## What lives here

- `code/place.org/AGENTS.md` — agent-collaboration conventions
- `code/place.org/CLAUDE.md` — Claude-specific working notes
- `code/place.org/README.md` — project README
- `code/place.org/app/(desktop)/layout.tsx`, `code/place.org/app/(desktop)/page.tsx` — desktop surface scaffolding
- (full Next.js app under `code/place.org/app/` — explore on demand)

## Where it connects

- Inspires: `codebase-place-companion`, `codebase-place-org-openclaw`, `docs-host-system-launchpad-hq`, `docs-vault-wiki`
- Concept donor for: every `ux-metaphor` topic node

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/codebase-place-org:code/place.org/AGENTS.md
git show origin/codebase-place-org:code/place.org/app/'(desktop)'/layout.tsx
```
